risks.title: Dependence on sales seasonality
risks.score_rationale: MD&A explicitly states: 'Our business is seasonal and as a result, our net sales fluctuate from quarter to quarter. Net sales are usually highest in the fourth fiscal quarter due to the year-end holiday season.' Major impact on cash flow and quarterly results.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: MD&A mentions gross margin and operations risks. Subsequent Events note Supreme Court February 2026 ruling on IEEPA tariffs: 'The ultimate availability, timing, and amount of any potential refunds of such tariffs remain hig' creating uncertainty.

risks.title: Increased competition affecting comparable sales
risks.score_rationale: Comparable sales is central KPI for Five Below. MD&A states: 'we may not be able to effectively identify and respond to changing trends and customer preferences' and 'we may not be able to find desirable locations for new stores and that we may not be able to effectively manage our future growth'.

risks.title: Rising operating costs
risks.score_rationale: MD&A indicates: 'our planned store expansion will place increased demands on our operational, managerial, administrative and other resources'. Financials confirm store and corporate expenses: $988.995M FY2025 vs $797.060M FY2024 (+24.2% YoY).

risks.title: Dependence on new stores for growth
risks.score_rationale: MD&A explicitly states: 'we plan to open approximately 150 net new stores in fiscal 2026' and 'Our ability to open profitable new stores depends on many factors'. Strategy entirely focused on expansion (377 net stores in 2 years = +24.4%).

risks.title: Variability in freight, shipping costs and inflation
risks.score_rationale: MD&A: 'In response to increasing commodity prices or general inflation, we seek to minimize the impact...by sourcing our merchandise from different vendors and changing our product mix.' COGS rising rapidly: $3,049.461M FY2025 vs $2,523.865M FY2024 (+20.8%).

ai_positioning.summary: Five Below did not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its fiscal 2025 10-K annual report.
